notes: Data-driven 30-60 second crisis puzzles with 1-fail hints, recovery setbacks, and 'What would a real mission planner do?' explanations.

solar_flare.title: Solar Flare Alert: Route Storm Shielding!
solar_flare.intro: High-energy protons from a NASA DONKI solar flare are sweeping across the outpost! Match the 3 shield grid power sliders to block the incoming proton beam direction before dose spikes.
solar_flare.hint: Look at the target Shield Sectors bar: balance North, Core, and Hab shields so every sector meets its green target total without exceeding your 100% power budget!
solar_flare.realPlannerAction: Real NASA flight controllers halt all outdoor spacewalks, route crew to hydrogen-rich water walls inside storm shelters, and power down non-essential science instruments.
solar_flare.setbackMessage: The proton wave grazed the outer hull (+14 mSv crew dose), but the crew sheltered safely and recovered. Next time, keep backup battery ready for shield routing!

dust_storm.title: Dust Storm Wall: Allocate Emergency Power!
dust_storm.intro: Swirling Martian dust has cut solar power to 30%! Distribute your scarce emergency kW budget across Life Support, Heating, and Greenhouse so crew stays safe.
dust_storm.hint: Life Support (O2 & Water) and Habitat Heating ALWAYS come before Greenhouse grow lights during a short dust storm!
dust_storm.realPlannerAction: Real planners shed non-critical science and lighting loads first, preserving life-support fans and thermal heaters until winds clear solar arrays.
dust_storm.setbackMessage: Batteries dipped low and a batch of lettuce slowed down (-12 kWh), but life support held firm! Always protect O2 and heating first.

power_failure.title: Grid Brownout: Reconnect Circuit Breakers!
power_failure.intro: A sudden load spike tripped the main power bus! Toggle the 4 circuit breakers in order to rebuild a steady path from Backup Power to Life Support without overloading.
power_failure.hint: Turn ON Main Bus and Battery Tie FIRST, keep Heavy Drills OFF, then switch ON Life Support!
power_failure.realPlannerAction: Mission Control restores power sequentially from smallest critical load to largest, avoiding a second surge trip.
power_failure.setbackMessage: Crew ran on emergency helmet O2 for a few minutes (-10 kg O2) while rebooting the bus — remember to shed heavy loads before reconnecting!

micrometeoroid_leak.title: Hull Pressure Drop: Patch Micrometeoroid Leaks!
micrometeoroid_leak.intro: A tiny grain of space rock pinged the habitat roof! Click all 3 flashing breach tiles on the hull map to seal them with quick-set patch resin.
micrometeoroid_leak.hint: Scan the red-pulsing hull grid squares and tap each breach once to lock the pressure seal!
micrometeoroid_leak.realPlannerAction: Astronauts isolate the affected module hatch, locate acoustic hissing leaks with ultrasonic sensors, and apply Kapton/epoxy patch kits.
micrometeoroid_leak.setbackMessage: Cabin pressure dipped before the last seal set (-12 kg O2), but emergency tanks refilled the habitat smoothly!

recycler_jam.title: ECLSS Jam: Rotate Water & O2 Pipes!
recycler_jam.intro: Mineral buildup jammed the ECLSS water filter loop! Click pipe tiles on the 3×3 manifold to rotate them so water flows cleanly from INTAKE (top-left) to CLEAN TANK (bottom-right).
recycler_jam.hint: Start from the top-left INTAKE tile and twist each pipe elbow so its glowing cyan flow reaches the bottom-right CLEAN TANK!
recycler_jam.realPlannerAction: ISS flight engineers bypass the clogged filter bed onto a backup distillation loop while astronauts swap the cartridge.
recycler_jam.setbackMessage: Backup filters caught the overflow (-18 L water), keeping crew hydrated while the main line cleared!

crop_problem.title: Greenhouse Alert: Rescue Wilting Crops!
crop_problem.intro: Leaves are drooping in the Bio-Dome! Use the NASA Garden Guide rules to pick the right LED spectrum, misting schedule, and airflow fix.
crop_problem.hint: Check the Garden Guide: NASA Veggie plants love 16h Red+Blue LED light and Aeroponic Mist (too much flood water drowns roots in space!).
crop_problem.realPlannerAction: NASA botanists inspect root-zone oxygen, adjust LED photoperiods, and balance nutrient misting rather than flooding plant pillows.
crop_problem.setbackMessage: A few outer leaves yellowed (-2 kg fresh veggies), but new shoots sprouted healthy once misting stabilized!
